capabilities.name: Long-task finish line
capabilities.user_visible_contract: Long work has observable finish conditions, only required open items, and evidence for every completed condition.
capabilities.runtime_evidence_required: A pending long task must survive a Hook round trip and become delivered only after the recheck.
capabilities.live_evidence_required: A real long Codex task stops at its accepted finish line without adding unrelated work.

capabilities.name: Attention restoration
capabilities.user_visible_contract: Startup, resume, clear, and compact restore only the current long-task goal, finish conditions, open items, and next action.
capabilities.runtime_evidence_required: Both runtime adapters inject the same minimal state shape.
capabilities.live_evidence_required: A resumed or compacted Codex task recovers its next action without treating old state as permission.

capabilities.name: Real user message reconsideration
capabilities.user_visible_contract: Every real user message is reconsidered as continuation, correction, replacement, or unrelated work; an internal delivery continuation is skipped.
capabilities.runtime_evidence_required: Both adapters inject the reminder for real prompts and stay silent for the internal marker.
capabilities.live_evidence_required: A mid-task correction changes only the requested part and then resumes unaffected work.

capabilities.name: Mechanical tool boundaries
capabilities.user_visible_contract: Tool hooks do not guess intent from Shell text and do not block ordinary reading commands.
capabilities.runtime_evidence_required: Common read commands and composed reads produce no permission decision or goal reminder.
capabilities.live_evidence_required: A real Codex task runs cat, test -e, a quoted alternation search, and a read pipeline without false blocking.

capabilities.name: Chain order enforced on identity and ledger
capabilities.user_visible_contract: On both runtimes the seat order (menxia pass → shangshu → executors → integration → delivery) is enforced by the chain gate on seat identity and the task ledger; Codex seats use Desktop codex_app project threads and Claude seats remain .claude/agents.
capabilities.runtime_evidence_required: A live chain run on each runtime shows a denied premature create/send/write with the gate's reason and a completed chain with hook-stamped seat records.
capabilities.live_evidence_required: One real task per runtime passes through menxia → shangshu → executor → integration → delivery with the gate active.

capabilities.name: One long-task delivery recheck
capabilities.user_visible_contract: A finished or blocked long task gets one same-model delivery recheck; a short reply is delivered immediately.
capabilities.runtime_evidence_required: Pending becomes delivered on the second Stop and no-state Stop stays silent.
capabilities.live_evidence_required: A real long-task final is rechecked once while a direct one-sentence question is not regenerated.

capabilities.name: Plain direct reporting
capabilities.user_visible_contract: Replies default to simple natural language without hiding decisions, risks, evidence boundaries, or remaining work.
capabilities.runtime_evidence_required: Resident rules and the long-task Stop prompt carry the same delivery principle without a style scorer.
capabilities.live_evidence_required: A real Codex report is understandable without session context and does not dump internal mechanics.

capabilities.name: Visible role and skill initialization
capabilities.user_visible_contract: Every Codex role is visibly titled in the current project, uses a local thread, and cannot perform phase work until its role-bound native skills have a matching hash receipt.
capabilities.runtime_evidence_required: Session metadata lists project skills; each seat transcript reads its mapped SKILL.md files; the task ledger contains valid skill_load receipts for Zhongshu, Menxia, Shangshu, and Executor.
capabilities.live_evidence_required: A real Codex task shows 中书省, 门下省, 尚书省, and 执行体 threads simultaneously through final delivery, all in the saved project, with no worktree setup failure.

capabilities.name: Opt-in chain: one skill per runtime, one kernel
capabilities.user_visible_contract: Ordinary chat is the default on both runtimes; the three-departments chain starts only when the user invokes the `agentos` skill. On Codex the invoking thread becomes a courier (relay) that records the user's exact words, opens 中书省, and carries messages verbatim both ways. On Claude the invoking session itself becomes 中书: it records the user's words verbatim, sends 门下 the raw words, 尚书 the approved package, and talks with the user directly between phases. An invocation with no task content opens nothing. Unbound sessions see silent hooks; pause/stop/resume are main-seat records that freeze the ledger for every seat.
capabilities.runtime_evidence_required: Hook tests show an unbound session produces no injection, deny, or Stop block; a main-seat create binds the session (relay on Codex, 中书 on Claude) and denies --done-when, a non-verbatim goal, a bad task id, or an invocation without task content; a multi-paragraph user_message is verbatim with its newlines; pause/stop freeze every seat's ledger writes and stop-gates until resume.
capabilities.live_evidence_required: A plain session in a project chats without any AgentOS output; `$agentos` (Codex) opens 中书省｜<readable-task-title>｜<task-id> and the user's exact words reach it unchanged; `/agentos <task>` (Claude) makes the session itself 中书, which answers the user directly, shows 门下省/尚书省/执行体 subagents with the same title and id, and delivers once; the session is ordinary chat afterwards.

capabilities.name: Seat identity and no-lock-up guarantees
capabilities.user_visible_contract: A seat keeps its identity however the runtime spawned it (named or teamed spawns fall back to the runtime's spawn metadata; seat spawns are normalized to plain boolean subagents), no gate can lock the chain (every waiting gate names its exit, seats never sleep-poll), and the task ledger is written only through its CLI. The 2026-08-18 Cognition_AGENTOS lock-up (executor identity lost, 尚书 waiting an hour) cannot recur by the same path.
capabilities.runtime_evidence_required: Gate tests: a hook input whose agent_type is a spawn name resolves to the seat named by agent-<id>.meta.json customAgentType; a seat spawn carrying name/team_name/string run_in_background is rewritten (keys dropped, real boolean) and isolation is refused; sleep loops by 中书/门下/尚书 are denied; integration before execution_result is denied with the --status blocked exit named; direct edits or redirects into agent-os/state/tasks/ are denied.
capabilities.live_evidence_required: A real Claude task whose 尚书 spawns an executor completes with the executor's own execution_result in the ledger and 尚书's integration recorded; no seat waits more than one gate message without a named exit.
